name: Hungry Cat
storyline: Meet a world-traveling cat with a big appetite! The charming orange cat is always up for an adventure - especially when there’s food involved! Join him as he journeys through iconic countries - rolling burgers in the USA, greeting croissants in France, enjoying sushi in Japan, solving ancient puzzles for treats in Egypt, and exploring Brazil, Morocco, and beyond. Each destination offers themed logic puzzles and unique food challenges.
summary:
Hungry Cat: Puzzle Game Adventure - A Fun Brain-Teasing Journey!

Ready to challenge your brain with a relaxing puzzle journey full of food, fun, and furry cuteness? Meet the adorable orange cat who’s always hungry - and always on the move! In Hungry Cat, a brain-teasing physics-based puzzle game, you’ll travel across the globe and solve clever block puzzles to roll delicious local food into the paws of your favorite kitty.

Whether you love logic games, enjoy testing your quiz-solving skills, or just want a light, relaxing game with cute characters, Hungry Cat is your perfect choice.
